narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Three plus one plus five is nine, so z must be zero. That is the only answer.
<bookmark mark='more'/>But nine is not the only multiple of nine that a digit sum can reach.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>We have to try the next multiple before we can say only.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, three thousand one hundred and five divided by nine is three hundred and forty five.
<bookmark mark='check2'/>Three thousand one hundred and ninety five divided by nine is three hundred and fifty five.

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu sees that three, one and five make nine, so z is zero, and calls it the only answer. Eighteen is also a multiple of nine, so z can be nine too.
